items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: And that's why he and Pinkertour had quite an argument one time.

ctx.x: I wanted to ask you about who some of your favorite banjo players were back in those times.

Well, I liked Jules. He was fine. And Billy Eastwood was very good. Billy tuned his banjo. Now, Billy could play both tunings. But Billy tuned his banjo ukulele styling. And that's why he and Pinkertour had quite an argument one time. And so Pinkertour says, all right, all right. He put up a piece of music. He says, for instance, he says, now with that tuning you can't play this piece. He says, here's a piece. Play this piece. And he put it up there and Billy took the piece and he just took his banjo and played…
